title: Ci Refactor
head: Ci-refactor
body: Split lint, typecheck (tsc), and tests into parallel jobs so they run concurrently and report results independently. Added an aggregate job that runs after the parallel jobs complete and fails the workflow if any of them failed, so you get full visibility into which checks passed/failed while ensuring the final status reflects any failures. The build step now runs only if tests succeed. Kept the existing Postgres service and prisma migrate for the test job.
